{{Youmay|the Imperial Merchant Galactic Academy|the [[Merchant Academy]]}}
The '''Imperial Merchant Galactic Academy''' trained civilian [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] for the [[Merchant Galactic/Legends|Merchant Galactic]], a supply and logistics auxiliary fleet of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the time of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Based on [[Rhinnal/Legends|Rhinnal]], its graduates would serve for an obliged period in the [[Imperial Supply]] Fleet before following their own careers on commercial [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]]. In large part because of its indirect ties to the Navy, it was also part of the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] system.
